class.name: JenkinsBridge
class.description: Build feature that mirrors a Jenkins job into this TeamCity build configuration

function.name: jenkinsBridge
function.description: Adds Jenkins Bridge mirroring to the build configuration

param.name: connectionId
param.description: ID of the Jenkins Bridge project connection

param.name: jenkinsJob

param.description: Number of recent Jenkins builds to mirror on the first sync; defaults to 1
